cards.title: Feedback
intro: Choose setting to automatically send feedback invites. The invite will be sent to all valid bookings.

fields.label: Request feedback from bookings that were created after this date:
fields.help: Bookings created before this date will not be sent a feedback request.

fields.label: Request a provisional feedback (after the 4th session)
fields.help: The request for feedback will be sent after the fourth session.

fields.label: Request feedback after programme has finished
fields.help: The request for feedback will be sent after the last programme session.

cards.title: Google reviews
intro: Choose when Zooza asks customers on this programme to leave a Google review.

fields.label: Don't ask anyone registered before
fields.help: Customers who registered before this date will not be asked for a review.

fields.label: Ask after registration
fields.help: Request a review shortly after a customer registers.

fields.label: Ask after the first attended session
fields.help: Request a review once the customer has attended their first session.

fields.label: Ask after the class has ended
fields.help: Request a review after the programme has finished.
